text:
Sam: Heads up — main pipeline went red right after the merge. smoke-scheduler job timed out repeatedly. CI run: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/3912345600. Can someone grab this?
Priya: Which merge/PR was that?
Sam: PR #1457 (models/runtime) commit 7f3c2ab — touched scheduler config + pool selection.
Jonah: I can take first pass. Quick skim of the logs shows: 
```
SchedulerTimeout: no heartbeat for 180s
  at scheduler.go:412
  last heartbeat from worker: 2026-03-17T12:02:41Z
```
Priya: Trying a targeted rerun of just smoke-scheduler now: `/rerun smoke-scheduler`
CI Bot: Re-run queued by Priya for job `smoke-scheduler`. New run id 3912345699.
DevOps Oncall: FYI I'm watching alerts. If rerun fails we should consider an immediate revert of the config change. Pinging @eng-runtime for visibility.
Priya: Rerun completed and failed with same timeout. stacks look identical.
Jonah: Reproduces on a small staging stress run I just kicked off. Suspect the scheduler config tweak in the PR — it increased `max_wake_delay` and changed the GPU pool selector.
Priya: Here's the diff that landed in #1457: 
```
- max_wake_delay: 100ms
+ max_wake_delay: 500ms
- gpu_pool_selector: fast-gpus
+ gpu_pool_selector: preferred-gpus
```
Jonah: That 5x wake delay could make heartbeats miss under load. Also `preferred-gpus` sometimes routes to nodes with higher contention.
Sam: Could be a real regression. Priya — can you open a revert/rollback PR for the scheduler config so we can get main green?
Priya: Opening revert now, will disable automerge on the revert and request immediate review: revert PR #1460 created.
CI Bot: Revert PR #1460 opened by Priya. Auto-merge disabled.
Jonah: I'll run a quick bisect locally to confirm the change set. Command I'm using: `git bisect start HEAD 7f3c2ab^ && git bisect run ./scripts/run-smoke.sh`
Priya: Thanks. If bisect confirms, let's land revert and then run full smoke matrix.
DevOps Oncall: Adding temporary alert suppression to avoid paging churn while we triage. Will re-enable after revert lands or we have a plan.
Sam: Sounds good. Keep updates here — if anyone finds it's infra (node flakiness) instead, shout out. :eyes: 
Jonah: Update — bisect points at 7f3c2ab as likely cause. I'll attach artifacts in the PR thread.
Priya: Revert landed, CI on revert triggered. Fingers crossed.
CI Bot: CI run 3912345850 for revert PR #1460 started.
DevOps Oncall: Monitoring smoke runs now.
Sam: Great work, team. Please follow up if any surprising failures after revert. :thumbsup:
